episodes.synopsis: The Arcana Famigila protects Regalo Island with powers granted to them the Tarocco. At birthday party for the head of the family, “Papa” Mondo, he tells them he is thinking about retirement and the Arcana Duello will begin.
episodes.title: La Notte del Compleanno (The Night of the Birthday)

episodes.synopsis: Felicitá remembers the joy of her first day joining the family. But those memories are pushed aside when her thoughts turn back to the upcoming Arcana Duello.
episodes.title: Il Comandante della Squadra Protezione Animali (Commander of the Animal Protection Team)

episodes.synopsis: Piccolino is the annual children event held by the Family, Pace, Debito, and Luca discuss growing up together.
episodes.title: Piccolino (Little One)

episodes.synopsis: Libertá memories of his child hood start to come back after trying to put out a fire. Which leads to a confrontation with his mentor Dante.
episodes.title: Confessioni di una Maschera (Confession of A Mask)

episodes.synopsis: Libertá is not the only one dealing with memories of the past. Nova who has been a part of the family since childhood, has never fully felt comfortable.
episodes.title: Amici d'Infanzia (Childhood Friends)

episodes.synopsis: Pirates have landed in Regalo Island and have kidnapped Nova’s father, Moreno. The family is told to wait but Nova, Liberta, and Felicita move to rescue Moreno without permission.
episodes.title: La Bordo! La Battaglia Finale (All Aboard! The Final Battle)

episodes.synopsis: Felicitá has gone missing and none of the house staff can find her. Libertá and Nova have been tasked by Mama to find her and deliver a letter.
episodes.title: Rispettivi Segreti (Their Secrets)

episodes.synopsis: Debito, Luca, and Pace have been friends since childhood and they all share a hatred for Jolly.
episodes.title: La Luna nel Buio (The Moonlight in the Darkness)

episodes.synopsis: Felicitá has insisted on learning the truth behind Elmo. When she finally does, the answer is bigger than expected. The truth involves the entire family and their contracts with the Tarocco.
episodes.title: La Ruota della Fortuna (The Wheel of Fortune)

episodes.synopsis: With the use of her 2nd arcana power, Felicitá has lost memories. The family is distraught and the one who caused this mess might be the only person to fix it.
episodes.title: Arcana Famiglia (Arcane Family)

episodes.synopsis: Felicitá bravery in using her powers has sparked other members of the family to come to term with their Arcana powers and prepare for the duel.
episodes.title: Arcano Triangolo (Mysterious Triangle)

episodes.synopsis: The Arcana duello and to save Papa she must be a pick a lover. The duello will unleash everybody power and desire.
episodes.title: Arcano Duello (Arcane Duel)
